segments.normalizedSource: ```swift import CoreSpotlight class QueryExample { private var query : CSSearchQuery? = nil mutating func executeQueryWithHandlers(withTitle title : String) { var results = [CSSearchableItem]() // Fetch the items with a title that starts with the // specified string. Perform a case-insensitive comparison. let queryString = "title == '\(title)*'c" let context = CSSearchQueryContext() context.fetchAttributes = ["title", "displayName", "keywords", "contentType"] // Create the query and specify a handler for the results. self.query = CSSearchQuery(queryString: queryString, queryContext: context) self.query?.foundItemsHandler = { (items : [CSSearchableItem]) -> Void in results.append(contentsOf: items) } // Display the results when the query finishes. self.query?.completionHandler = { (error) -> Void in if error == nil { for item in results { let attributeSet = item.attributeSet let foundTitle = attributeSet.title let foundDisplayName = attributeSet.displayName // Use the results here. } } else { // Handle the error. } } // Start the query. self.query?.start() } } ```
